houses.name: Rhino River General
houses.line: Hold the line, secure the fords, and watch our flanks.

houses.name: KITE'S SWEEP
houses.line: Speed wins. Take the east ford early and hold it.

houses.name: Orchid's Patient Ascent
houses.line: Patience is the root of victory. Let our rivals bleed their ambitions.

houses.name: Tiger's River Watch
houses.line: Hold the middle ground, watch the flanks. Patience is our strongest blade.
